title: Restore
subtitle: Restore point of {when} ({id})
filesHelp: What you pick comes back in a new restored-… folder in the website's home. Nothing there now is changed; move what you need.
empty: This folder is empty in the restore point.
browseFailed: The restore point could not be read.
databasesHelp: The database goes back to how it was. What it holds now is saved first, as a .sql file in the restored-… folder.
mailboxesHelp: The messages come back in a new mail folder, Restored-…, next to what is in the mailbox now. Subscribe to it in the mail program if it does not show.
confirmFiles: Restore {path} into a new restored-… folder?
confirmDatabase: Put {name} back as it was? Its current content is saved first.
confirmMailbox: Bring back the messages of {email} into a new Restored-… folder?
